# Deposited MATLAB source

The `.m` files in this directory are the diagnostic and figure scripts from the code deposit for Thompson et al., *Communications Earth & Environment* (2026), doi:10.1038/s43247-026-03673-y.

Code and data deposit: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19981347

They are included here so the Python port can be compared with the original source. PySWOT-GEM-omega did not write them. Headers already present in the figure scripts, including the initials AFT and the update dates, are left unchanged. `CreateDensityFields.m` has no author or DOI line; the Zenodo record above is the attribution for that file and for this directory as a whole.

NetCDF, MAT, and zip files from the same deposit are not stored in git. Retrieve them with `scripts/download_zenodo.py`.
